div.div: Figure 1. Architectural blueprint of Model 1 (Simple CNN baseline). Input tensors pass through four convolutional stages with batch normalization, ReLU activations, and max-pooling downsampling. Adaptive average pooling collapses feature maps to a 256-D embedding prior to multi-layer perceptron projection.
